import bpy,json,inspect
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace.get('harbor_craft',{})
print('NAMESPACE',{'patches':len(ns.get('patches',{})),'materials':list(ns.get('materials',{})),'png':bool(ns.get('png'))})
for cn in ['Harbor_Arrival_Landing','Coast_CraftWarehouse']:
 c=bpy.data.collections[cn]
 points=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for o in c.objects if o.type=='MESH' for v in o.bound_box]
 print('BOUNDS',cn,[min(v[i] for v in points) for i in range(3)],[max(v[i] for v in points) for i in range(3)])
 print('COMPONENTS',[(o.name,[round(x,3) for x in o.dimensions], [m.name for m in o.data.materials]) for o in c.objects if o.type=='MESH' and any(k in o.name for k in ['LandingDeck','freight','barrel','Lamp','Rope coil','Veranda board 0'])][:35])
